selection_design: Freeze all twelve actual model hashes, manifests and row membership before inference. No fitting or threshold retuning.
road: All three located archives of staged held/new locations (extra_cal, newroads, shapes). Main set: recorded position >=25m and every point on its registered MGeo link >=25m from every prior 14331 selection and earlier whole-frame held/development camera location. Compute exact point-to-polyline minimum. >=50m camera clearance as sensitivity. Count true distinct links, weight each link equally. Distinct-map and prospective capture are different claims.
repeat: All twenty pixel-unique dated November archive_rpc drives with verified RGB and Semantic. Use complete manifest sessions, within-session 64-frame windows, 10% ceil per window. Report both pooled and equal-session error. Use shared 50m XY tiles for paired error sensitivity on repeated paths.
boundary: Actual IoU [0.65,0.75), failure <0.70. Compare at predicted IoU <0.70 and old calibration-only normal-score lower 10% cutoff. Report FP/normal, FN/failures, undefined, distinct groups and paired intervals. Undefined IoU remains in review slots, excluded from supervised rates.
decision: Primary use is whole-frame IoU prediction. Keep previous 99 as the research default unless the same alternative beats it by >=0.003 mean absolute IoU error on BOTH spatial link macro and temporal session macro for each seed and does not lose review hits on either domain for any seed. If 99 is worse than 96 by >=0.003 on primary spatial macro for all seeds, with 95% paired link-bootstrap excluding zero for the reference seed, flag spatial transfer failure and do not confirm a general-purpose upgrade. Otherwise heterogeneous findings require reporting domain-specific limits on the chosen engineering default.
inference: 2000 paired bootstrap draws, resample links for static, shared 50m XY tiles for movement, seed 23411. Fixed operational budget and boundary accuracy are secondary. Report both signed and absolute differences. Masks, predefined thresholds and hyperparameters unchanged.
scope: Previously collected paired sensor images. The new road designation is with respect to the quality-feature selection data available at row level, not all prior project studies. Additional historical ROI selection cohorts A/B have published aggregates without their complete raw poses in the workspace.
